name: jsettlers-heldout-served
purpose: Held-out JSettlers table for the planner_pv2_tiles promotion: planner_offer_accept alone vs three all-SMART JSettlers 2.6.10 robots on seeded games (base seed 20261110, 512 games), paired by game name with the other policy's run (experiments/tiles-heldout.json).
analysis: Paired with the other policy's receipt by scripts/jsettlers_paired.py (see experiments/tiles-heldout.json).
limitations: The patch file is GPLv3-derived and lives only in runs/external (never in this repo); its sha256 is pinned here. all_smart makes every locally started robot use JSettlers' SMART strategy params, including our extrabot's inherited fallback brain.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-08 before any game. Same server settings, patch v2 (paired luck: board, deck, first player, seats, dice-by-roll), all-SMART robots, game count and base seed as its pair; only the policy differs.
